test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

She said, “I am in no mood to work now.”

options.text: She said that she has been in no mood to work then.
She said that she was in no mood to work now.
She said that she was in no mood to work then.
She said that she has been in no mood to work now.

solution:
The correct answer is **She said that she was in no mood to work then.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
In the original sentence, "She said, 'I am in no mood to work now,'" the verb is in the present tense ("am") and the time reference is the present ("now").
